name: Humation
description:
Humation is the official avatar creator. Pick a hairstyle, outfit, accessory and colors, or roll a random one from a seed, and download it as SVG or PNG for any profile.

Every avatar is rendered locally from the Humation 1 asset set with @humation/core. The same packages are open source, so the creator doubles as a live demo of what you can build.
